availability.note: IM6 PREMIUM live in the MG configurator with a price on 2026-11-26; three grades (Premium, Platinum, Performance), matching CarExpert's range guide.

listPrice.note: No list price published; MG prices IM drive-away only (configurator header 'Drive Away Price'; CarExpert, Chasing Cars and the NRMA all call launch prices drive-away). Configurator shows $60,990 struck through (regular national drive-away; launch-era Platinum $69,990 and Performance $80,990 were cut to $67,990/$77,990, Premium unchanged at $60,990) and $57,990* including a $3,000 cashback on IM5/IM6 sold and delivered 01 Nov-31 Dec 2026 (campaign, not used; $500 accessories bonus and Black Friday servicing/charger offer also ignored). Back-out: (60990 - 958.80) / 1.042 = 57,612; round-trip driveAwayPrice(57687) = 60,989.85. Independent check: the configurator's VIC per-state 'discounts' (which cancel on-road costs so every state lands on one national figure) are $4,370.15 / $4,655.75 / $5,058.95 for Premium / Platinum / Performance; the steps of $285.60 (= 34 x $8.40 duty units) and $403.20 (= 48 units) imply dutiable gaps of ~$6,800 and ~$9,600, matching the backed-out list gaps of $6,718 and $9,597 rather than the $7,000 and $10,000 drive-away gaps. Configurator T&Cs say the drive-away includes the maximum dealer delivery charge, so this list may overstate the true list by roughly $1,000-2,000 (the VIC discounts imply on-roads ~$1,000 above the app's model). Re-derived 2026-11-27 for VIC rego $958.80 (was 57,687 at $880; round trip 60990.50).

rangeKm.note: MG AU brochure 'Driving Range: WLTP Combined Cycle (km)' per ADR 81/02, 20-inch wheels as the AU grade ships; brochure separately lists NEDC figures (505/670/600), not used. Direction test: below EV Database's UK WLTP best case where published (Long Range TEL 625; Performance TEH 505).

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: CarExpert spec table 'Energy consumption', footnoted 'Green Vehicle Guide data' (AU label, includes charging losses). batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 16.3, within the 25% cross-check.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: MG AU brochure 'Boot Volume with Seats in Place (L)'; measurement method not stated (search snippet of CarExpert's dimensions database labels 665L 'Rear Seat Up to Lower Window' but the page would not render). 32L frunk not added.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: MG AU brochure 'Boot Volume with Seats Folded (L)'; method not stated.

warrantyYears.note: IM warranty: non-commercial 5 years/unlimited km; 7 years/unlimited km Extended Warranty only with exclusive servicing at an authorised IM dealer (conditional, in pros). HV battery 8 years/160,000km. IM is excluded from MG's 7/10-year terms (explore/warranty).

insuranceAnnual.note: Held value kept: anchored to mg-im5 (2000/2200/2800 at the same prices), tesla-model-y (2300 at $58,900, 2550 at $68,900, 3200 at $84,900) and xpeng-g6 (1750-2100). IM6 sits slightly above IM5 as a larger, heavier SUV; Performance reflects 572kW.

depreciationCurve.note: Mainstream default; owner decision 2026-11-26 that every MG row (MG, IM, HS) uses it, despite list cuts and cashbacks that would otherwise argue for a steeper curve.
